label: Compiled-routing closure is literal-free apart from its pins: the complete `.skilled/bin` sweep returns 14 `sk-code-opencode` matches - 4 in `.skilled/bin/tests/compiled-route-surface-hint.test.cjs` (mode-order assertions) and 10 in the promoted sk-code canary fixture (expectedModes/expectedIntents); the front door, layout selector, resolver, engine, compiler, activation state and manifests carry none.

Resolution chain reads the hub registry JSONs at route time (F1.11 follow-up closed): front door -> layout selector -> `014-runtime-engine/lib/resolve.cjs` (flag + activation-manifest gates; sk-code = servingAuthority 'compiled', generation 2) -> `014-runtime-engine/lib/compiled-route.cjs` (per-hub HUB_CHILD map) -> `harness/build-artifacts.cjs#loadSnapshot` reads `.opencode/skills/sk-code/{mode-registry.json, hub-router.json, SKILL.md}` -> compileRegistry -> snapshot -> canary-router evaluateCanary. Rename consequence: no closure code change; renaming hub-JSON surface entries changes the compiled policy, while the F1 test+fixture pins must be updated or regenerated.

Promoted closure regenerates from an authored program dir whose compiled outputs DO carry the name: serving-closure.manifest.json declares generatedFrom specs/sk-doc/z_archive/019-skill-routing-refactor/015-router-unification-program (62 files); the authored sk-code child holds compiled/policy.json, compiled/route-gold.typed.json, compiled/PolicyCardV1.md and the canary fixture with the literal; buildArtifacts() regenerates them (writes compiled/ + activation/). The generator's repo-root sentinel is `.opencode/skills` (line 36) and SKILL_ROOT `.opencode/skills/sk-code` (line 44) - the `.opencode` exclusion must keep these untouched.

Mirror topology: `.opencode/skills`, `.devin/skills` and `.claude/skills` are symlinks to `../.skilled/skills` (a .skilled rename flows through, no second edit); `.hermes` is the only materialized mirror - 7 real SKILL.md copies carry the literal (surface packet + sk-code, sk-code-quality [34 matches], sk-code-review, sk-code-webflow, sk-code-obsidian, system-spec-kit); `.codex`/`.cursor` hold no skills tree; the full-tree sweep returned no other mirror-root carrier.

Live-vs-history split: the case-insensitive identity sweep matches 2,378 files; 2,229 sit under specs/ (history + active packets, incl. this run), leaving ~149 non-spec files - ~12 more than the seed's strict-spelling 137, i.e. the broader spelling set adds about a dozen non-spec files.

Prior rename precedent in the same z_archive tree: `030-mode-sk-prefix-rename` shipped a rename-map.json plus a dedicated `003-sk-code-rename` packet and an `011-rename-fallout-remediation` summary; sibling programs `022-legacy-hub-compiled-routing-refresh` and `024-cli-external-hub-manifest-remint` show the post-rename recompile/remint pattern for compiled routing.
